text_block_list.text:
After the race concluded...
Tokai Teio let out a deep sigh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really want some snow-aged carrot steak
and additive-free carrot juice right now!
choice_data_list: Right this second is a bit...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! No way, no way! I'm starving,
so do something about it~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "I'm working this hard, so praise me more~!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio is acting unusually selfish and fussy.
She must be thoroughly exhausted.
Perhaps I should reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
